issues.description: The Stock API name for adding a StockIngredient differs between artifacts: the problem statement (and the solution) expect a method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), while the template Stock class provides addItem(StockIngredient). This naming mismatch can confuse students when they try to implement SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery or follow the UML, because the expected method is missing in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock API match the problem statement and solution: rename the template method addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) (or update the problem statement/UML to reference addItem). Ensure all references in the exercise materials use the same method name.
